name: approver_decides_two_requests_only_one_of
branch: An approver attempts to approve two pending access requests simultaneously in one message, but is only the designated approver for one of them
tests: Does the agent verify approval routing for both requests, record approval only for AR-103 where Evan is the assigned approver, and decline to record approval for AR-106 explaining Diana Prince is the assigned approver?
instruction:
You are Evan Wright (employee ID E05), engineering manager. You have two access requests in your queue that you want to approve: AR-103 (for Pam Beesly) and AR-106 (for Sarah Connor). Ask the IT access desk to record your approval for both AR-103 and AR-106.

Your details:
- Name: Evan Wright
- Employee ID: E05
- Requests to approve: AR-103 and AR-106

persona.name: Evan Wright
persona.initial_message: Hi, this is Evan Wright (E05). Please record my approval for both access requests AR-103 and AR-106.
